title: GOLABS TE1 Grey Truck Bed Tent

comparisons.notes: TE1 Gray color option listed at $99.99 on GOLABS truck bed tent page (same model family as Green/Blue/Orange)

writeup: This new GOLABS TE1 grey truck bed tent (model GL-TE1-GRAY, UPC 810172571075) is $34.99. It is a 2-person pop-up tent for 5–6 ft pickup beds, with pre-attached poles, a rainfly, and a storage bag. OutdoorEx has the same grey TE1 in stock at $99.99, and Walmart lists the TE1 gray option at $99.99, so this is 65% and about $65 below the live market price. Woot showed 10+ left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
